claim_level: speculative band under stated assumptions; NOT an identification

prefill_angle.method: N_active <= MFU * peak_effective * S / (2 * R); R from the measured marginal prefill slope

assumptions.peak_basis: quantized serving assumed (fp8 ~990 on H100/H200-class; int4/NVFP4-class 1300-2000; bf16-dense B200-class ~2250); low end 400 covers fp8 on smaller parts
assumptions.concurrent_streams_B: 1 (conservative: batching with other tenants only lowers the per-stream bound)
assumptions.regime: compute-bound batched prefill (165k tok/s marginal is far above memory-bound decode rates)

prefill_angle.legacy_note: bf16 dense, A100/H100-class; what the first pass assumed
prefill_angle.reading: Serving this marginal prefill rate on 1-4 quantized-serving-era accelerators bounds the ACTIVE footprint at roughly 0.3-12.26B parameters; multi-tenant sharing only lowers the bound. The dated bf16/A100 grid gave 0.19-2.72B - about 2-4x lower.

capability_angle.basis: Jev's direct-answer MMLU-Pro/GPQA sit at/above the no-thinking Claude 3.7 row and beside Qwen 3.5 9B's reasoning-protocol scores; a 2025-era ~9B-class instruct model is the nearest published analog, with a 4-14B dense-equivalent band to absorb protocol mismatch and vintage effects. HLE 21.9% and ARC-AGI-2 0/120 exact cap it far below frontier sizes.
caveats: capability bands are loose: hundreds of models share this band
distillation shifts capability-per-parameter upward (a distilled 1-4B can sit in this band on knowledge MCQs)
MoE models are sized by ACTIVE parameters in this band too

conventions_note: 2N FLOPs/token counts weight matmuls only; attention adds ~2*L*d_model per token per layer, which at <=29k context and typical small-model widths is <15% of the total - inside the assumption ranges.

reconciliation.tension: throughput angle: 0.3-12.3B ACTIVE (quantized-serving assumptions); capability angle: 4-14B dense-equivalent. Under the revised assumptions the bands OVERLAP (joint zone ~4-12B).

readings.statement: a dense ~4-9B model served at fp8/int4 fits BOTH angles with no further machinery; this is the simplest hypothesis consistent with everything measured
readings.independent_evidence: the $0.042/M price and 73 ms floor are consistent with small-model single-host serving

readings.reading: MoE (possible; the capacity-density argument favors it)
readings.statement: an MoE with ~15-100B total at ~5-20% activation (active ~1-8B) also fits, and would explain the TOP of the capability band with less compute per token; if the model is dense instead, its capacity density is superlative for the band
readings.independent_evidence: none - the API cannot see expert structure (ARCHITECTURE-ANALYSIS.md sec.5)

readings.statement: a distilled 2-6B dense model can reach the bottom of the 4-14B capability band on knowledge MCQs (teacher labels transfer knowledge, not reasoning) - and Jev's recognition>>production asymmetry is exactly that shape
readings.independent_evidence: weak/indirect: generation tax (83.1% MCQ vs 13.6% digit read-out), HLE near floor, brand prior (ARCHITECTURE-ANALYSIS.md sec.6)

readings.statement: if serving is more aggressive than assumed (int4, S>4, MFU>0.45), active could sit at 1-4B with distillation supplying the capability

reconciliation.converged_statement: Two-sided best guess after the quantized-serving revision: ACTIVE parameters most plausibly ~4-9B (the overlap of the 0.3-12.3B throughput bound with the 4-14B capability band), i.e. dense-equivalent order 4-9B - a 2025-era small model. A dense quantized model in this range needs no MoE to reconcile the angles; an MoE (~15-100B total) remains possible and unfalsifiable from the API. TOTAL parameters unconstrained either way. NOT a parameter claim from latency alone: the throughput angle is an explicit-assumptions bound, not a slope-to-size conversion.
what_would_tighten_it: a matched-protocol capability evaluation (removes band looseness)
the staged P2 option-cost probe at large K under load (bounds per-token marginal compute more tightly)
